ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two vertical blue straight lines, the left one passes through points Q and T, and the right one passes through points R and S. Oblique line QR connects Q to R from upper left to lower right, and oblique line TS also connects T to S from upper left to lower right. Angle 1 is located at point Q, between the two vertical lines and above QR; angle 6 is located at point R, between the two vertical lines and below QR. Reasoning: It is known that QT ∥ RS, therefore oblique line QR is a transversal of these two parallel lines. Angle 1 and angle 6 are both between the two parallel lines, and are located on opposite sides of transversal QR, so they are alternate interior angles. When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate interior angles are equal, therefore m∠6 = m∠1 = 131.

raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $QR \| TS$, $QT \| RS$, and $m\angle 1 = 131$. Find the measure of $\angle 6$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two parallel vertical lines QT and RS cut by the slanted segment QR. In the image, angle 1 is at Q, inside the strip between the vertical lines and above QR; angle 6 is at R, inside the strip and below QR. From the text, use QT ∥ RS and m∠1 = 131. Treat QR as a transversal of the parallel lines QT and RS. Angles 1 and 6 are alternate interior angles, so they are congruent. Therefore m∠6 = 131.

推理：已知 QT ∥ RS，因此斜线 QR 是这两条平行线的截线。角 1 和角 6 都在两条平行线之间，并且位于截线 QR 的相对两侧，所以它们是内错角。平行线被截线所截，内错角相等，因此 m∠6 = m∠1 = 131。

method.method_draft: Read the figure as quadrilateral Q-R-S-T with opposite sides parallel: QR ∥ TS and QT ∥ RS. In the image, ∠1 and ∠2 are adjacent at Q on the straight line QT, split by segment QR; ∠2 is the interior angle of the parallelogram at Q, and ∠6 is the interior angle at R. From the text, m∠1 = 131, so by the linear-pair rule m∠2 = 180 − 131 = 49. Since QT ∥ RS and QR is a transversal, consecutive interior angles ∠2 and ∠6 are supplementary. Thus m∠6 = 180 − 49 = 131.
